newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down against dollar on intervention.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down against dollar on intervention.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.3069 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 8.3058, on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market because of intervention by the central bank, dealers said.
The yuan opened up at an intra-day high of 8.3055 and moved around 8.3060 for most of the session, before falling to close at a low.
Trading was active, with most done at 8.3059, traders said.
"The yuan was still consolidating around 8.3060," said one dealer.
"The central bank pushed down the yuan late in the session to make the market more active and dampen the strong sentiment in favour of the yuan," the dealer added.
Dealers expect the yuan to rise slightly to about 8.3060 on Thursday.
The yuan closed almost unchanged at 7.5912 from 7.5911 against 100 Japanese yen and ended down at an intra-day low of 1.0745 from 1.0735 against the Hong Kong dollar.
